sentences.text: Sri A.M.Nagaraju  Senior Food Safety Officer  Kanakapura - 562 117  Kanakapura Taluk The Proprietor vs The Additional Deputy Commissioner ...

on 28 November, 2017 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/8523043/
1  Ramanagara District ... Respondents

This Miscellaneous First Appeal is filed under Section 71(6) of the Food, Safety and Standards Act,
2006 praying to set-aside the order passed by the 1st respondent in case No.FSSA 01/2014-15 dated 23.12.2016.
This appeal coming on for orders this day, the Court made the following:
ORDER Heard the appellants' counsel on maintainability of this appeal.
2. Learned counsel for the appellants submits that the appeal is maintainable.
3. The impugned order shows that it was passed by the Deputy Commissioner, exercising the powers under Section 68 of the Food, Safety and Standards Act, 2006 ('Act' for short).
4. The Deputy Commissioner is the Adjudicating Officer and according to Section 70 of the Act, any order passed by the Adjudicating Officer is appealable to the 'Tribunal'.
This Appeal is not maintainable and therefore, it is dismissed.

Sd/-
JUDGE KMV*
